test_title: PYST 35: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I - Mathematics (Held On: 19 Jun, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: maths
question: If at the same rate of interest, in 2 years, the simple interest is ₹40 and compound interest, compounded annually, is 41, then what is the principal (in ₹)?
solution:
**Given:**

SI (2 years) = ₹40

CI (2 years) = ₹41

**Formula used:**

Difference (CI − SI for 2 years) = P × (R/100)²

**Calculation:**

Difference = 41 − 40 = 1

⇒ P × (R/100)² = 1 ...(1)

SI for 1 year = ₹20 ⇒ P × R / 100 = 20 ...(2)

From (2), R/100 = 20 / P

Substitute in (1): P × (20/P)² = 1

⇒ 400 / P = 1

⇒ P = 400

**∴ Principal = ₹400**
